fun_facts: Demond Williams Jr. was born in Chandler, Arizona.
As a high school junior, he completed 68% of his passes for 2,339 yards, with 23 touchdown passes and just one interception.
That junior season, he also rushed for 764 yards and five touchdowns.
As a high school senior, he threw for 3,250 yards and 34 touchdowns, with just three interceptions.
At Washington, he set the school’s single-game total-offense record with 538 yards. In that game, he also became the 16th FBS player to throw for at least 400 yards and rush for at least 100.
